children: Deutsche Lufthansa shares are likely to rise after the company's latest quarterly update showed good results across various lines and pointed to strong pricing momentum into the fourth quarter, analysts at J.P. Morgan say in a research note. The German airline group reported adjusted EBIT above consensus expectations, with pricing in its network airlines and costs excluding fuel both landing better than JPM anticipated. "The key question mark is whether the current strong pricing environment can continue given the Asia comparative headwind and [mid-single-digit percentage] capacity growth, in order to offset fuel," the analysts say. Lufthansa shares closed at 7.47 euros on Monday. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
